boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten no-additional-purchase ways for currently enrolled Gaels to spend time together, using student facility access or unreserved public park amenities.

cards.entity_name: Joseph L. Alioto Recreation Center Swimming Pool
cards.title: Meet at the JARC pool
cards.subtitle: Joseph L. Alioto Recreation Center
cards.notes: Bring your SMC ID and meet friends for a swim or poolside reset. Check the facility calendar before heading over, since access requires student eligibility.
cards.short_summary: A campus pool hang using enrolled-student recreation-center access.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Mary's lists a swimming pool among JARC amenities and states that all students currently enrolled in SMC classes have access to the facility.
cards.source_title: About the Facility | Saint Mary's College
cards.access_notes: For currently enrolled SMC students; facility policies require a current waiver and check-in.

cards.entity_name: Joseph L. Alioto Recreation Center Climbing Wall
cards.title: Try the JARC climbing wall
cards.subtitle: Joseph L. Alioto Recreation Center
cards.notes: Plan a climbing session with a friend and follow the wall’s certification and safety requirements. Confirm availability and any required check-in before you go.
cards.short_summary: A supervised indoor climbing option within student facility access.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Mary's lists a climbing wall among JARC amenities and states that all students currently enrolled in SMC classes have access to the facility.
cards.source_title: About the Facility | Saint Mary's College
cards.access_notes: For currently enrolled SMC students; comply with climbing-wall policies and any certification requirements.

cards.entity_name: Joseph L. Alioto Recreation Center Double Gymnasium
cards.title: Set up a gym-court session
cards.subtitle: Joseph L. Alioto Recreation Center
cards.notes: Coordinate a casual basketball, volleyball, badminton, or indoor-soccer session when the double gym is available. Review the facility calendar before gathering a group.
cards.short_summary: Multiple court sports fit in the JARC double gymnasium.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Mary's identifies the JARC double gymnasium for basketball, volleyball, indoor soccer, and badminton; all currently enrolled SMC students have facility access.
cards.source_title: About the Facility | Saint Mary's College
cards.access_notes: For currently enrolled SMC students; court availability can vary, so consult the facility calendar.

cards.entity_name: Joseph L. Alioto Recreation Center Functional Training Room
cards.title: Train together in the functional room
cards.subtitle: Joseph L. Alioto Recreation Center
cards.notes: Make a simple partner workout plan and use the functional training room during open access. Keep the session within posted rules and share equipment considerately.
cards.short_summary: A flexible indoor workout space for a low-key training meet-up.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Mary's lists a functional training room among JARC amenities and says all currently enrolled SMC students have access to the facility.
cards.source_title: About the Facility | Saint Mary's College
cards.access_notes: For currently enrolled SMC students; check in and follow JARC facility rules.

cards.entity_name: Joseph L. Alioto Recreation Center Group Exercise Room
cards.title: Move in the group exercise room
cards.subtitle: Joseph L. Alioto Recreation Center
cards.notes: Use an available group exercise room for stretching or a low-impact movement break with friends. Confirm room availability through the facility calendar before arriving.
cards.short_summary: An indoor space suited to shared movement and stretching.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Mary's lists a group exercise room among JARC amenities and says all currently enrolled SMC students have access to the facility.
cards.source_title: About the Facility | Saint Mary's College
cards.access_notes: For currently enrolled SMC students; availability may be affected by scheduled programming.

cards.entity_name: Joseph L. Alioto Recreation Center Fitness Area
cards.title: Do a fitness-area check-in
cards.subtitle: Joseph L. Alioto Recreation Center
cards.notes: Meet for a self-paced cardio or strength session, then cool down together. Bring your SMC ID, check in at the desk, and follow posted equipment guidance.
cards.short_summary: A student-accessible campus fitness hang with cardio and strength equipment.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Mary's describes a 13,800-square-foot JARC fitness area and says all currently enrolled SMC students have access to the facility.
cards.source_title: About the Facility | Saint Mary's College
cards.access_notes: For currently enrolled SMC students; check in at JARC and follow facility policies.

cards.title: Play a round at Moraga Commons
cards.subtitle: Moraga Commons Park, 1425 St. Mary's Road
cards.notes: Bring discs if you have them and play the course at your own pace. Use the park’s availability information and give reserved areas priority to permit holders.
cards.short_summary: A public-park disc-golf outing near campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The Town of Moraga lists a disc golf course at Moraga Commons Park and says areas not reserved are available first-come, first-served.
cards.access_notes: Use only unreserved areas; park hours are one hour before sunrise to one hour after sunset.

cards.title: Roll a bocce game at the Commons
cards.subtitle: Moraga Commons Park, 1425 St. Mary's Road
cards.notes: Gather a small group for a relaxed bocce game at an unreserved area. Check availability first and leave the space ready for the next park visitors.
cards.short_summary: A casual public-park game with first-come access when unreserved.
cards.evidence_claim: The Town of Moraga lists bocce ball at Moraga Commons Park and says areas not reserved are available first-come, first-served.
cards.access_notes: Use only when not reserved; park hours are one hour before sunrise to one hour after sunset.

cards.title: Meet at Lamorinda Skatepark
cards.subtitle: Moraga Commons Park, 1425 St. Mary's Road
cards.notes: Bring your board, skates, or scooter and use the park during posted hours. Follow all onsite signs and make room for other riders using the facility.
cards.short_summary: A named Moraga Commons skatepark with posted daily access hours.
cards.evidence_claim: The Town of Moraga identifies Lamorinda Skatepark at Moraga Commons Park and states that it is open from 9 AM to dusk.
cards.access_notes: Open 9 AM to dusk; follow all posted signage.

cards.entity_name: Moraga for Monarchs Habitat and Demonstration Garden
cards.title: Read the Monarch Garden signs
cards.subtitle: Rancho Laguna Park, Moraga
cards.notes: Walk the garden path slowly, read the plant identification and interpretive signs, and look for pollinators without disturbing them. Keep to designated public areas.
cards.short_summary: A civic pollinator garden with artwork, benches, and interpretive signage.
cards.evidence_claim: A Town of Moraga proclamation documents the Moraga for Monarchs Habitat and Demonstration Garden at Rancho Laguna Park, including benches, plant identification, and interpretive signage.
cards.source_title: Town of Moraga Proclamation Honoring Moraga Garden Club
cards.access_notes: Visit during Rancho Laguna Park’s general-use hours and respect plantings, wildlife, and posted rules.
